title: Minimum Denominations

story.briefing: The charge must land on the figure exactly, and every cell you use costs a mounting slot. Use as few cells as you can.
story.success: Exact charge assembled with the fewest cells. Slots to spare.

description: Given an array of distinct positive cell sizes and a target, return the fewest cells needed to sum to exactly the target. Any size may be used any number of times. Return -1 if the target cannot be reached exactly. A target of 0 needs 0 cells.
hints: Taking the largest size that fits, repeatedly, is wrong — the first example is built to prove it. Every size has to be considered at every total.
The fewest cells for a total is one more than the fewest for that total minus some size. Try every size and keep the smallest result.
Build a table from 0 up to the target, starting at 0 for total 0 and infinity elsewhere. For each total, try each size that fits and keep the smallest. Convert a remaining infinity to -1.
